headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Lose $487 Million as Bitcoin Holds Near 84k and Greed Outruns a Flat Cycle
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487.07 million on the Oct. 7 print, ether funds lost $160.77 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin trades near 84k, up 0.30%. Fear and greed reads 57, labeled greed, while the cycle index sits flat at 55, so sentiment is running ahead of the cash leaving the listed funds and ahead of a cycle score that is not climbing with the mood. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short print, the dollar is firm at 102.32, and volatility is compressed, with the VIX at 15.49 and seven-day realized volatility at 19.24 against 48.87 over thirty days, so the outflow is meeting shorts and a quiet tape rather than a leverage chase.
author: jordan
